title: Airline ontology
description: Portable airline semantics imported from the supplied Lattice ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: airline
  title: Airline Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Airline decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: airline-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:384b9f7332b29306810c67feea4185b3337e37a367e25898a84ed622cf6c65f9
spec:
  types:
    - id: aircraft
      label: Aircraft
      description: A governed physical airframe participating in airline operations.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: aircraft.aircraft_id
          label: Aircraft Id
          description: Stable aircraft identifier (tail number or MSN).
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: aircraft.aircraft_type
          label: Aircraft Type
          description: Aircraft model such as B737, A320, A350.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: aircraft.registration
          label: Registration
          description: Civil aviation registration.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: aircraft.operational_status
          label: Operational Status
          description: Current operational status such as active, grounded, in maintenance.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: aircraft.manufacturer_serial_number
          label: Manufacturer Serial Number
          description: MSN assigned by the OEM.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: aircraft.lessor
          label: Lessor
          description: Lessor if aircraft is leased.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
        - id: aircraft.delivery_date
          label: Delivery Date
          description: Date of delivery to the airline.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/6
    - id: flight
      label: Flight
      description: A scheduled or operated flight segment between origin and destination.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: flight.flight_number
          label: Flight Number
          description: Marketing or operating flight number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: flight.flight_date
          label: Flight Date
          description: Scheduled or operated date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: flight.origin_airport
          label: Origin Airport
          description: IATA origin airport code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: flight.destination_airport
          label: Destination Airport
          description: IATA destination airport code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: flight.scheduled_departure
          label: Scheduled Departure
          description: Scheduled departure time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: flight.actual_departure
          label: Actual Departure
          description: Actual off-block or departure time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: flight.status
          label: Status
          description: Flight status such as scheduled, departed, arrived, cancelled, diverted.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
        - id: flight.cabin_class
          label: Cabin Class
          description: Primary cabin class configuration.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/7
    - id: passenger
      label: Passenger
      description: A traveler identified in a governed booking, ticket, or PNR.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: passenger.passenger_id
          label: Passenger Id
          description: Stable passenger record locator.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: passenger.full_name
          label: Full Name
          description: Passenger full name as appears on ticket.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: passenger.loyalty_number
          label: Loyalty Number
          description: Frequent flyer loyalty program number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: passenger.loyalty_tier
          label: Loyalty Tier
          description: Loyalty program status such as Gold, Platinum.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: passenger.fare_class
          label: Fare Class
          description: Booked fare class such as Y, J, F.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
    - id: booking
      label: Booking
      description: A reservation or PNR for one or more passengers on flights.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: booking.pnr
          label: PNR
          description: Passenger Name Record locator.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: booking.booking_date
          label: Booking Date
          description: Date booking was created.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: booking.booking_channel
          label: Booking Channel
          description: Channel such as direct web, OTA, GDS, agent.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: booking.total_amount
          label: Total Amount
          description: Total booking amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: booking.currency
          label: Currency
          description: Currency code of the total amount.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: booking.booking_status
          label: Booking Status
          description: Confirmed, pending, cancelled, flown, no-show.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
    - id: irregularity_event
      label: Irregularity Event
      description: A disruption affecting a flight such as delay, cancellation, diversion, or mishandled bag.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: irregularity_event.event_id
          label: Event Id
          description: Stable identifier for the irregularity.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: irregularity_event.event_type
          label: Event Type
          description: Type such as delay, cancellation, diversion, denied boarding.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: irregularity_event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred At
          description: Time the irregularity occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: irregularity_event.cause_code
          label: Cause Code
          description: IATA delay code or root cause.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: irregularity_event.compensation_amount
          label: Compensation Amount
          description: Compensation paid to passengers.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: irregularity_event.delay_minutes
          label: Delay Minutes
          description: Length of delay in minutes.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
    - id: maintenance_event
      label: Maintenance Event
      description: A scheduled or unscheduled maintenance action on an aircraft.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: maintenance_event.event_id
          label: Event Id
          description: Stable identifier for the maintenance event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: maintenance_event.maintenance_type
          label: Maintenance Type
          description: A-check, B-check, C-check, line maintenance, unscheduled, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: maintenance_event.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Maintenance start time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: maintenance_event.completed_at
          label: Completed At
          description: Maintenance completion time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: maintenance_event.work_order
          label: Work Order
          description: Work order or task card identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: maintenance_event.description
          label: Description
          description: Narrative description of the maintenance performed.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
    - id: crew_member
      label: Crew Member
      description: A pilot, flight attendant, or dispatcher assigned to operations.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: crew_member.crew_id
          label: Crew Id
          description: Stable crew identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: crew_member.full_name
          label: Full Name
          description: Crew member full name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: crew_member.role
          label: Role
          description: Captain, First Officer, Purser, Flight Attendant, Dispatcher.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
        - id: crew_member.license_number
          label: License Number
          description: License or certificate number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/3
        - id: crew_member.base_airport
          label: Base Airport
          description: IATA code of crew base.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/4
    # Shared core types
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/14/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: flight_operated_by_aircraft
      label: OPERATED_BY_AIRCRAFT
      description: Flight operated by an Aircraft.
      sourceTypeId: flight
      targetTypeId: aircraft
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: maintenance_event_on_aircraft
      label: MAINTENANCE_ON
      description: Maintenance event performed on an aircraft.
      sourceTypeId: maintenance_event
      targetTypeId: aircraft
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: irregularity_event_affects_flight
      label: AFFECTS_FLIGHT
      description: Irregularity event references a flight.
      sourceTypeId: irregularity_event
      targetTypeId: flight
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: booking_for_passenger
      label: FOR_PASSENGER
      description: Booking references a passenger.
      sourceTypeId: booking
      targetTypeId: passenger
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: booking_includes_flight
      label: INCLUDES_FLIGHT
      description: Booking includes a flight segment.
      sourceTypeId: booking
      targetTypeId: flight
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: crew_assigned_to_flight
      label: ASSIGNED_TO
      description: Crew member assigned to a flight.
      sourceTypeId: crew_member
      targetTypeId: flight
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/11
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/12
